scope: All 100 test suites in the portable baseline; its other three entries are helper modules. Port-required and retired suites were not executed.
notes: Seven explicitly unavailable modules were left unresolved so unrelated suites could execute. No emission stubs were used. Affected suites remain failures.
A passing suite means its existing assertions passed; inventory and capability-report tests do not prove unavailable deployment targets work.
The timeout retained 19 passing lexer cases. The next case in name order exercises legacy FFI trivia-arena storage; its hang remains unresolved.

Failures include subprocess-based CLI tests, unavailable legacy providers, wide numeric dependencies, documentation dependencies, and test fixture services. Failure samples are evidence, not a claim that every failure has one cause.
This interpreted coverage run is not the collector-stress acceptance gate.
